Paths stay host-local unless a scoped diagnostic explicitly needs one; no secret values. Externally managed installations stay read-only until an Admin explicitly adopts a supported install. UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.

tables.name: worker_checks
tables.purpose: Latest machine readiness check results with generation-bound freshness
tables.constraints: One latest result per (worker_host_id,check_id,component key) via a unique index; history goes to bounded audit/diagnostic evidence. Results carry the host generation and inventory revision they were observed at: stale reports cannot replace a newer result or grant capability, old-generation or expired checks cannot restore ready, and fresh failed checks block the gated capability (credential isolation blocks all claims). Safe reason text is bounded and Problem-referenced; server receipt/expiry times are authoritative (five-minute initial expiry, immediate invalidation after a relevant update, configuration change or process restart). UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.

tables.name: model_provider_accounts
tables.purpose: Organization-owned provider account identity with account-level quota observation
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(organization_id,provider,identity_hash): account health and quota are keyed to verified provider/billing account identity, so multiple machines using the same account share one observation and remaining usage is never multiplied. Unverified identities are never merged; a display email alone does not prove the same billing account. Unknown or unverifiable quota stays null with its source and observation time, never coerced to zero. Different organizations never discover each other's account identity through deduplication. Raw billing identity values are never returned. UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.

tables.name: worker_provider_bindings
tables.purpose: Explicit authorized provider account placement on one machine component
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(worker_host_id,component_key,provider); provider identity is not mutable freeform config. Native credentials remain local; secret references never imply unrestricted access, and credentials never inherit the supervisor's worker credential or privileged integration secrets. Reconnect and disconnect affect the named binding; disconnect blocks new use immediately, fences affected active authorization and requests best-effort local cleanup that an offline machine cannot acknowledge. auth_generation increments on each winning authentication so stale host reports are fenced. UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.

tables.name: worker_provider_auth_attempts
tables.purpose: Scoped expiring provider-login attempts with protected challenges
tables.constraints: One active attempt per binding (partial unique index over pending/challenge_issued); bounded lifetime and one winning completion. protected_state holds encrypted temporary protocol state and is never returned raw; login challenge/reveal responses are session-scoped, non-cacheable and never events. A winning completion authenticates the identity and binds the account inside the same organization transaction; raw claims never create a verified account identity, cross-binding completion is refused, and terminal-only adapters record the explicit local handoff instead of a fabricated remote flow. Duplicate exact reports replay the same acknowledgment. UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.

tables.name: preview_grants
tables.purpose: One-use browser handoff to isolated preview origin
tables.constraints: UNIQUE token_hash; POST handoff body, no URL token; 30 second one-use grant -> isolated HttpOnly session; reauthorize repository on access. UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.

tables.name: budget_accounts
tables.purpose: Installation and run budget ledgers
tables.constraints: Installation scope is one global deployment-wide UTC monthly account with organization_id and run_id null. Run scope requires both organization_id and same-organization run_id and has one lifetime account. UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT(scope,organization_id,run_id,period_start); all currency values are NUMERIC(14,6). Lock the global installation account before the run account. Late/unknown settlement retains the original reservation; fixed provider costs keep provider/account/billing-period dedupe.

tables.name: budget_action_intents
tables.purpose: Immutable model-action admission projection
tables.constraints: The intent and paired holds are inserted before enqueue. UNIQUE(organization_id,dedupe_key); changed immutable content or pins are conflicts; missing policy or agent version fails closed.

tables.name: budget_reservations
tables.purpose: Concurrency-safe spend hold
tables.constraints: Exactly one of run_step_id or external_effect_id is set. A reservation may reference the global installation budget account while retaining non-null organization_id for attribution; run-account reservations require the composite same-organization account FK. UNIQUE(budget_account_id,dedupe_key); cap before dispatch. Expiry triggers reconciliation and never refunds work that may still spend.

tables.name: user_preferences
tables.purpose: Private organization-specific workbench settings for one person
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(organization_id,principal_id). Current membership required. Preferences are bounded private presentation state and never grant access. UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.

tables.name: plugin_state
tables.purpose: Versioned bounded state isolated to one plugin install and optional personal owner
tables.constraints: UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT(plugin_install_id,owner_principal_id,namespace,key). Owner agrees with personal install; shared state requires organization scope. Value is bounded and schema validated; secrets remain references. UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.

tables.name: plugin_installs
tables.purpose: Organization or personal installation pinned to one package version
tables.constraints: Personal scope iff owner_principal_id is non-null; organization scope iff null. Selected version belongs to package. UNIQUE NULLS NOT DISTINCT over organization/package/scope/owner. Disable/uninstall blocks new authority; in-flight work keeps its pinned version but observes live revocation. UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.

tables.name: plugin_versions
tables.purpose: Immutable validated plugin manifest and bundle identity
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(plugin_package_id,version_name); UNIQUE(bundle_digest). Manifest and file-digest archive are immutable and bounded. Bundle bytes live behind the R2/filesystem storage boundary, not Postgres. UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.

tables.name: plugin_packages
tables.purpose: Stable private package identity published by an organization
tables.constraints: UNIQUE(organization_id,name). Public visibility exposes package metadata only, never organization state. Initial delivery uses private packages; public SDK/marketplace publication remains later. UNIQUE(organization_id,id) supports composite foreign keys; tenant-owned parent references are constrained to the same organization unless this record documents a host-owned exception.
